title: The Programming Language That AI Cannot Replace
full_monologue: The programming language that AI cannot replace is human intuition. While AI can write code, it lacks the creativity, context, and emotional intelligence that humans bring. It's not about syntax—it's about solving real-world problems with empathy. AI follows rules; humans break them to innovate. So, what makes you unique as a programmer? Comment below.
